compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Three `.github` files contain repeated or stale comments identified by the audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. The pull-request template is user-facing documentation; only its redundant hidden routing block is in scope.

## Approach
Edit only standalone YAML comments and the leading hidden HTML block. Preserve YAML data and every visible contributor instruction byte-for-byte.

## Scope
- `codeql/codeql-config.yml` — Preserve the `docs/**` exclusion and unchanged default query suite. Correct packaging rationale: the wheel packages `src/rebar`; the sdist includes `src/rebar`, `tests`, and `README.md`; both omit `docs/**`.
- `dependabot.yml` — Correct both stale Actions-only statements. Preserve monthly GitHub Actions updates, weekly uv updates, the committed-lock/no-pip rationale, Gerrit advisory-PR posture and lockdown exemption, deliberate cooldown omission, security-alert posture, and the `mcp` major-version ignore until `bared-nickel-insect` lands. User-facing follow-up is `rhyolite-saddening-aidi`.
- `pull_request_template.md` — Condense only the leading hidden Gerrit-routing block. Preserve all visible instructions and links exactly.

Consumers are CodeQL, package/release policy, Dependabot, repository lockdown, GitHub contributors, and documentation-link checks.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only the permitted comments/docstrings or blank lines in the declared files; executable/configuration data and exact behavior-bearing directives remain unchanged.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked TSV semantic matrix authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row confirming that redundant, obvious, duplicated, stale, or historical prose was removed while current rationale remained.
- [ ] Recorded focused checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and repository lint pass at the leaf commit.
- [ ] Missing or FAIL semantic rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded content-only guards, focused checks, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint. The independent matrix, not exact prose matching, judges semantic preservation.

verify_commands.dd_text: Prove the YAML files change only standalone comments or blank lines.

verify_commands.command:
rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -c 'import re, subprocess
p = ".github/pull_request_template.md"
read = lambda rev: subprocess.check_output(["rtk", "proxy", "git", "show", f"{rev}:{p}"], text=True)
visible = lambda rev: [line for line in re.sub(r"\A\s*<!--.*?-->\s*", "", read(rev), count=1, flags=re.S).splitlines() if line.strip()]
assert visible("HEAD^") == visible("HEAD")'
